name: smwgraphics-the-magical-quest-starring-mickey-mouse-pete-s-peak
title: The Magical Quest Starring Mickey Mouse - Pete's Peak
description:
A BG that needed its parts to be merged into a .zst to be ripped. The requester wanted to use palette 4 for the tornado animation. Speaking of that animation, the tornado animates, like in the original game. To be used with Horizontal and Vertical scrolling to Variable or Horizontal to Variable and Vertical to Constant.

Requested by qantuum.

Update: Not only did I re-organize the palette in such a way that not only palette 4 has been replaced with palette 1 without affecting SMW colors, but palette 5 has received its own rearrangement.

As a bonus, 4 tiles have been removed from the BG and map16 tile duplicates have been removed as well. Enjoy!
